cases.transcript:
Interviewer: Describe your caching implementation.
Candidate: I used cache-aside with Redis for product lookups and a five minute TTL. When a product is updated the service deletes the key after the database commit, so stale reads last only until the next miss.
Interviewer: What did you measure and what was the cost?
Candidate: I load tested it and the database read rate dropped. The cost is that two concurrent misses can both hit the database, so I added a short lock for hot keys.
